intro: Wingstop is all about wings, cooked to order in 14 bold flavors from Lemon Pepper and Garlic Parmesan to Atomic and Mango Habanero. Order them classic (bone-in) or boneless, add the seasoned fries or Louisiana Voodoo Fries, and dip in ranch or bleu cheese. Below is the full Wingstop menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: Wingstop serves classic (bone-in) and boneless wings in 14 flavors. A 10-piece wing combo with fries and a drink is about $17.49 for boneless and $18.99 for classic, the Boneless Meal Deal (20 wings, large fries, 2 dips) is $18.99, and the chicken sandwich is $5.99. Wings are cooked to order.
hot_deal: Wingstop value: the Boneless Meal Deal packs 20 boneless wings, large fries and 2 dips for about $18.99, and the chicken sandwich combo is just $7.99. Everything is cooked to order, so it's fresh but takes a few extra minutes. Wingstop also runs app deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How many flavors does Wingstop have?
faqs.a: Wingstop offers 14 flavors, split into dry rubs like Lemon Pepper, Garlic Parmesan, Hickory Smoked BBQ and Louisiana Rub, and sauces like Original Hot, Atomic, Mango Habanero and Hawaiian.

faqs.q: What is the difference between classic and boneless wings at Wingstop?
faqs.a: Classic wings are traditional bone-in chicken wings, while boneless wings are breaded white-meat chicken bites. Boneless are usually a bit cheaper; both come in all 14 flavors.

faqs.q: How much is a 10-piece at Wingstop?
faqs.a: A 10-piece wing combo with fries and a drink is about $17.49 for boneless and $18.99 for classic bone-in wings. The 20-wing Boneless Meal Deal is about $18.99.

faqs.q: Why does Wingstop take so long?
faqs.a: Every order is cooked to order, so your wings are fried fresh when you order rather than held under a heat lamp. That means a few extra minutes of wait for hotter, fresher wings.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Wingstop?
faqs.a: The best known are the classic and boneless wings, the Louisiana Voodoo Fries, the chicken sandwich, and the seasoned fries. Lemon Pepper and Garlic Parmesan are the top flavors.
